name: poly_fermat_quartic_4_4_2
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (a b c : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hab : IsCoprime a b) (hbc : IsCoprime b c) (hca : IsCoprime c a) (heq : a ^ 4 + b ^ 4 = c ^ 2) : a.natDegree = 0 ∧ b.natDegree = 0 ∧ c.natDegree = 0
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (a b c : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hab : IsCoprime a b) (hbc : IsCoprime b c) (hca : IsCoprime c a) (heq : a ^ 4 + b ^ 4 = c ^ 2), a.natDegree = 0 ∧ b.natDegree = 0 ∧ c.natDegree = 0
informal: Polynomial analogue of Fermat's quartic theorem: a^4 + b^4 = c^2 forces coprime nonzero a, b, c to be constant in char 0 (borderline case 1/4+1/4+1/2 = 1) — Uses Mathlib2.ms_fermat_catalan with (p,q,r)=(4,4,2), u=v=1, w=-1; the only work is the ringChar and the 1/p+1/q+1/r ≤ 1 side conditions.
type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (a b c : Polynomial k), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → c ≠ 0 → IsCoprime a b → IsCoprime b c → IsCoprime c a → a ^ 4 + b ^ 4 = c ^ 2 → a.natDegree = 0 ∧ b.natDegree = 0 ∧ c.natDegree = 0
